Earlier scenes:
很久以前，古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃。所以很多人常常吃不安全的植物，吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况。但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。

This scene:
他又聪明又努力，旅行很远找到很多植物。比方说，灵芝和夹竹桃。他一吃各种各样的植物就知道能不能吃这些植物。然后，神农写他的主意。他喜欢植物的味道，特别是花。神农遇到了一个黄色的花，一吃就觉得不舒服。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 然后，神农写他的主意：写下，他的发现

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 旅行很远：去很远的地方旅行，A travel destination needs a place phrase such as 去很远的地方; 很远 alone cannot serve as the destination after 旅行. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 写：写下，To mean recording an idea so that it is kept, use 写下 rather than the plain action verb 写. [vocab list]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个黄色的花：一朵黄色的花，朵 is the matching measure word for flowers; 个 is too general here. [rule: none]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农写他的主意：他写他的主意，Use a pronoun when the same character was mentioned in the immediately previous sentence and no other character competes as the referent. [rule: redundancy_delete]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农遇到了一个黄色的花：他遇到了一朵黄色的花，Use a pronoun for the same continuing character when the previous sentence already refers clearly to him. [rule: redundancy_delete]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 找到很多植物：找到了很多植物，Finding the plants is a completed action in this past narrative, so it needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 神农写他的主意：他写下了他的主意，Writing down the idea is presented as a completed narrative action, so 写下 takes 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 旅行 needs a destination phrase here, so 去很远的地方旅行 is correct.
The teacher marked 写 as needing 写下 for recording information.
Flowers take the measure word 朵 rather than the generic 个.
神农 has just been referred to as 他, so the continuing subject should be 他, but 写他的主意 still retains the teacher-marked wording problem.
The preceding sentence already clearly refers to 神农 as 他, so 他 is the appropriate continuing reference.
Finding the plants is the completed final action in this past sequence, so 找到了 is required.
写下了 correctly marks the completed action, but 他的主意 remains incorrect because the teacher required 他的发现.
